custom-error.description:
An error of the application's own, such as a server-side verdict on the
submitted number ("Only 40 seats left"). While it holds text the field is
invalid, blocks its form, shows the text in place of the help text at
once and is announced as invalid. It stops counting at the person's next
edit or step of the number, or when the form is reset, so it never blocks
the corrected answer. It outranks `error-text`.
When to use: report a verdict from a declarative spec, a live update or a
framework binding. Remove it when a new attempt starts.
When NOT to use: do not use it for `required`, the bounds or unreadable
text, which the field reports itself; `error-text` words those. Setting
the same text again while the prop still holds it shows nothing: remove
it first, then set it again.

decrease-label.description: Stepper's accessible name. The field label replaces {label}.

disabled.description: Prevents editing and excludes the control from form submission.

error-text.description: Validation hint to show when the entry fails a constraint. A `custom-error` outranks it.

format.description:
Intl.NumberFormat options for display. In HTML or a catalog spec, supply
these options as JSON text. The form value retains its original precision.

help-text.description: Context or instructions displayed beneath the field when it has no visible error.

increase-label.description: Stepper's accessible name. The field label replaces {label}.

invalid-number-message.description: Default validation message for text that cannot be read as a number.

label.description: Visible accessible name. Supply a meaningful label in the page language.

max.description: Maximum permitted numeric value. Omit for an unbounded maximum.

maximum-message.description: Polite adjustment message after exceeding the maximum. The formatted bound replaces {value}.

min.description: Minimum permitted numeric value. Omit for an unbounded minimum.

minimum-message.description: Polite adjustment message after falling below the minimum. The formatted bound replaces {value}.

name.description: Form-data key for the plain numeric value.

required.description: Whether the user must enter a number before submitting the form.

step.description: Positive increment for arrows and buttons. Page keys and Shift+arrows move ten increments.

steppers.description: Shows named decrease and increase buttons inside the field.

unit.description: Visible suffix such as seconds or seats, included in the accessible description.

value.description:
Current numeric value, or undefined when empty or unparseable. Use the
attribute for the form reset value. Property assignments are silent.

--ki-density-control-offset.description: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-number-input-border-block-end-width.description: Field border width at block end.

--ki-number-input-border-block-start-wid.description: Field border width at block start.

--ki-number-input-border-inline-width.description: Field border width at either inline edge.

--ki-number-input-field-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter behind the field.

--ki-number-input-field-bg-image.description: Optional theme image layered over the field fill.

--ki-number-input-field-disabled-border.description: Boundary when the entire field is disabled.

--ki-number-input-field-invalid-border.description: Field boundary when a validation message is visible.

--ki-number-input-font-size.description: Font size of the numeric entry and its suffix.

--ki-number-input-font-size-touch.description: Minimum input font size under a coarse pointer.

--ki-number-input-height.description: Medium field height before applying regional density.

--ki-number-input-label-gap.description: Gap between the label, field and supporting messages.

--ki-number-input-label-line-height.description: Line height of the field label.

--ki-number-input-line-height.description: Line height of the numeric entry and its suffix.

--ki-number-input-padding-inline.description: Inline padding for the plain field and unit suffix.

--ki-number-input-stepper-padding-inline.description: Editor inline padding between the steppers.

--ki-number-input-unit-bg.description: Backing of the unit suffix within the field.

--ki-number-input-unit-fg.description: Unit suffix ink. Medium emphasis in the standard contrast setting.

--ki-text-danger-high-em.description: semantic color for text danger high em.

--ki-text-high-em.description: semantic color for text high em.

--ki-text-supporting.description: Supporting text of an enabled control: field labels, placeholders, list secondary lines, quiet button labels and unselected tabs. A role, distinct from the med-em emphasis step it resolves to, so a mode can strengthen enabled supporting text without touching the disabled ink that also draws from med-em (directly, or through text.muted).

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.

--ki-typography-size-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.

--ki-typography-weight-body-normal.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body normal.

component.description:
A form field for a numeric quantity with optional stepper buttons, bounds,
locale-aware formatting, and a visible unit.

change.description: Composed event fired when the person commits an edited or stepped value. Read the host's numeric value. Listen to native input for live edits.

error.description: Polite validation feedback associated with the spinbutton.

field.description: Enclosure around the editor, unit and stepper buttons.

help.description: Help message associated with the spinbutton.

input.description: Native text editor carrying the spinbutton role.

status.description: Polite feedback explaining a value adjustment.

unit.description: Visible unit referenced by the spinbutton's description.
